description: Source code for ExternalAppendOnlyUnsafeRowArray class in Apache Spark, implementing an append-only array for UnsafeRow objects with in-memory and spill-to-disk capabilities.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyUnsafeRowArray
classes.description: An append-only array for UnsafeRow objects with in-memory buffering and spill-to-disk functionality.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the number of rows stored in the array.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the array is empty.

methods.name: spillSize
methods.description: Returns total bytes spilled into disk so far.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears resources and resets the array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an UnsafeRow to the array, switching from in-memory to spillable sorter if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: generateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over the current rows, starting from a specified index.
